proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.proximity_to_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The SRD activation condition 'while you are within 5 feet of this brazier' is a proximity gate on a stationary wondrous item (a brazier is not held or worn). No existing EquipmentPredicate variant covers proximity to a non-carried object. The censer analogously used holding_item because swinging implies holding, but the brazier cannot use that fiction — it is floor/table-placed furniture.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental.

notes: Core mechanics (spawned_creature family, catalog_ref Fire Elemental, dawn reset, 1-hour timed duration, bonus-action dismissal, shared initiative with immediately_after_caster turn order) all fit cleanly. The only gap is the proximity activation predicate, omitted from the encoding. The censer analog (holding_item) is not honest for a stationary brazier.
